name: 01985 · West Newbury, MA
findings: ZIP 01985 (West Newbury) has 29 nonprofit organizations. 15 of them (52%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is public events, listed by 12 organizations.
Hobby and sports organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (33% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 01985 (West Newbury) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 01985 (West Newbury) list public events in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 2.1 times the typical level).
